questions.question: What is the purpose of substation earthing?
options: To prevent electrical shock and equipment damage
questions.correctOption: To prevent electrical shock and equipment damage
questions.explanation: Substation earthing diverts fault currents to earth. It reduces shock risk and equipment damage.
explanationLines: Substation earthing diverts fault currents to earth.
It reduces shock risk and equipment damage.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: Which of the following is a type of system earthing arrangement in medium voltage systems?
questions.explanation: Unearthed neutral system is listed as an MV earthing arrangement. The neutral point is left isolated or floating.
explanationLines: Unearthed neutral system is listed as an MV earthing arrangement.
The neutral point is left isolated or floating.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: What does Step and Touch Voltage Regulation aim to control?
options: The voltage drop across transmission lines
The voltage difference during faults in substations
questions.correctOption: The voltage difference during faults in substations
questions.explanation: Step and touch voltage are voltage differences near faults. Regulations limit them for safety.
explanationLines: Step and touch voltage are voltage differences near faults.
Regulations limit them for safety.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: Substation earthing mats are primarily used for...........
questions.explanation: Earthing mat provides common earth for substation parts. It connects devices and metallic structures to ground.
explanationLines: Earthing mat provides common earth for substation parts.
It connects devices and metallic structures to ground.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: Equipment and neutral earthing are classified under which category?
questions.explanation: The unit places equipment and neutral earthing under earthing of equipment. Both connect parts or neutral to earth.
explanationLines: The unit places equipment and neutral earthing under earthing of equipment.
Both connect parts or neutral to earth.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: Equipment earthing is mainly provided for…..
questions.explanation: Equipment earthing protects the system from damage. Fault current passes to earth through the earthing wire.
explanationLines: Equipment earthing protects the system from damage.
Fault current passes to earth through the earthing wire.
questions.subject: industrial-installation-and-maintenance

questions.question: Earthing is necessary to ….
questions.explanation: Earthing protects people and equipment. It gives fault current a safe path to earth.

questions.question: What is the advantage of an earthed neutral system?
